ownerWords:

goal: Every customer crawler route has a /v1 route on api.virev.ai, and every documented /v1 route works on staging with its own docs example, page 2 included. A board decision (s5, s7) is the only reason a route stays out. DM routes are left out while p12 builds reader sends.

onMiss: Read the flagged rows. Match each failing group to its board item: p7 page 2, p8 crawler routes, p9 batch, p10 missing routes, p11 differing bodies. A group with no live job gets one fix job named for it, which fixes on staging (c50) and asks the chat only for the prod promote. A regression row (worked yesterday, fails now) goes to the chat with the route, status and error. broken_crawler rows go to the crawler-v3 owner as a note; do not patch the crawler from the portal side. A new /v1 route for a crawler route goes into sieun-pi scripts/duties/portal-parity.routes.json in the same job. If crawler-staging is down, say so once instead of chasing each route. No outside sends (c37), no merges (c49). All on target: end the turn with no message.
